title: CIRSEC Baselines - OpenSSH server effective configuration check spec

key.description: Lowercase keyword as printed by sshd -T. Check reads sshd -T, fix writes a drop-in in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/, validates with sshd -t and reloads ssh.

operator.description: How the observed value compares to value. match = regex.

value.description: Expected value. May be a single {{ parameter }}, resolved with its type.
